title_sq: Apartament - Për Shitje - Pallati me Shigjeta, Tiranë(ID: 530181010-3276)
description_sq:
Apartament 3+1+2 ne shitje perballe Delijorgjit!
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me dinamike te TIranes perballe kompleksit Delijorgji, ne nje objekt te ri me ashensor dhe 2 kate parkim nentoke.
I pozicionuar ne kat te larte dhe orientim nga lindja, apartamenenti ka nje planimetri perfekte te organizuar me korridor hyres, sallon te madh, ambient gatimi dhe ngrenie, per te vijuar me 3 dhomat e gjumit, njera prej te cilave me garderobe te vecuar si dhe me 2 tualete.
Ballkoni kryesor eshte i aksesueshem nga salloni i ndenjes dhe ofron pamje mbreselenese te qytetit dhe malit te Dajtit. Nderkohe ballkoni i dyte eshte i pozicionuar ne dhomen matrimoniale.
Apartamenti eshte i investuar me materiale nga me cilesoret, perfshire sistem termoizolimi te brendshem, dhe shitet i mobiluar si ne foto.
Se bashku me apartamentin ofrohet me cmim ekstra nje ambient garazh i mbyllur ne katin -1, i investuar dhe me hapesire parkimi per 3 automjete,
Prona eshte me certifikate pronesie!
title_en: Apartment - For Sale - Palace of Arrows, Tirana(ID: 530181010-3276)
description_en: Apartment 3+1+2 for sale in front of Delijorgji! The apartment is located in one of the most dynamic areas of Tirana, in front of the Delijorgji complex, in a new building with an elevator and 2 floors of underground parking. Positioned on the top floor and facing east, the apartment has a perfectly organized floor plan with an entrance hall, large living room, kitchen and dining area, followed by 3 bedrooms, one of which has a separate wardrobe and 2 bathrooms. The main balcony is accessible from the living room and offers impressive views of the city and Dajti mountain. Meanwhile, the second balcony is located in the matrimonial room. The apartment is invested with quality materials, including an internal thermal insulation system, and is sold furnished as in the photo. Along with the apartment, a closed garage on the -1st floor, invested and with parking space for 3 vehicles, is offered at an extra cost. The property has a certificate of ownership!
